description: Add or remove a reaction on an iMessage: a tapback (love, like, dislike, laugh, emphasize, question) or any single emoji. One reaction per person per message: a new one replaces yours. The person sees it.

emoji.description: Exactly one emoji, such as 😍 or 👍🏽, instead of a tapback. People on iOS 17 or earlier see it as a text.

reaction.description: A tapback. Pass this or emoji.

name: react_to_message
title: React to a message
